relations.delete: restrict; mandatory erasure removes dependent facts first using existing manifest/worker before deleting evidence.
No blind cascade on normal expiry. Dependency-aware cleanup and explicit privacy purge order.

relations.scope: shared proof; row pair/date/provider revision must match fact reporting context
relations.delete: restrict while referenced; no automatic replacement with latest revision.

fact_identity.serialization: Ordered tagged tuple -> deterministic UTF8 JSON -> SHA256; string/native IDs remain exact text, explicit null distinct from omitted. Required missing identity is held, never guessed. Hash collision or same hash/different canonical identity is conflict.
fact_identity.include: Family-specific original native grain plus semantic reporting scope. Daily aggregate identity includes actual business_date/timezone/time basis and relevant attribution/units/native breakdown dimensions. Ordered Product event identity uses native event ID; later day/Channel/role/mapping resolution cannot create a second event.
fact_identity.connection_rule: provider_connection_id and versions are freshly verified authority, not an automatic duplicate key for the same native account. Reconnect does not authorize disconnected-interval backfill; existing EO05D rule remains.
fact_identity.family_rule: Query family labels alone cannot distinguish overlapping observations of the same native sale. Native grain equivalence must be proven per family before persistence; unresolved equivalence blocks accepted facts.
fact_identity.updates: Native identity stable; same key+same content is replay, changed content is CAS revision/conflict under existing EO05C/D correction protocol. No blind last-write-wins. This proposal does not implement that protocol.
fact_identity.grain_version_change: A reviewed grain migration selects one authoritative version/projection for reporting. Coexisting old/new grain rows are not additive and must not both contribute.

extensions.storage: metric_extensions JSONB on three fact tables; no extension table.
extensions.registry: Versioned checked-in schema per table/provider/grain; SQL/writer allow only registered keys under selected version. Not a user-defined field or arbitrary provider-payload bag.
rules: Decimal values travel as exact strings; supported states and source unit/attribution meaning are validated before numeric interpretation.
A key cannot shadow a core metric, owner, identity dimension, currency, source proof, native Sales Role or security field.
New optional same-grain metric requires approved provider query/projection and typed registry/reader support; often no table migration, never zero code or automatic intake.
New identity/grouping dimension requires separate grain/key and aggregation review; cannot be hidden in metric_extensions.
Old schema remains readable; a field absent from prior requested coverage is unavailable/not_requested, not zero and not retroactively fabricated.
Re-reading old raw projection can recover only fields actually collected and retained with permission; a newly requested field may require separately approved native read.
Core promotion requires reviewed SQL/index/backfill compatibility and one authoritative metric read path; core and extension copies cannot both contribute.
No new derived KPI/arithmetic/cost allocation or user formula goes into source metric extension.
compatibility: Adding optional same-grain field retains native key and existing rows; payload digest/version changes only on supported actual enrichment.
Rename/type/unit/attribution/semantic change uses a new definition/version; cannot reinterpret historical values in place.
Registry version does not enter the native fact key.

numeric_policy.SQL: Unconstrained numeric initially, with explicit writer/SQL finite-format/range/length checks per metric definition; no fixed typmod that rounds provider values silently.
numeric_policy.transport: Canonical decimal text without JS Number conversion; safe existing number values must prove losslessness. Current common adapter JS number output is not precision proof.
numeric_policy.counter_rule: Source conversion quantities may be fractional; no unconditional bigint/integer cast.
numeric_policy.rounding: Only approved EO06 presentation/formula policy rounds; original amounts and source currency remain unchanged.

FX_policy.rate_reference: Exact immutable row by pair/date/provider/version; no hidden nearest/latest fallback.
FX_policy.same_currency: Proposed explicit identity state with multiplier 1 in versioned engine, fx_rate_id null; no fabricated remote-provider rate row.
FX_policy.missing: Native facts may be stored with FX state missing, but currency-converted totals/report-ready output remain blocked.
FX_policy.reporting_configuration: Server-verified workspace currency configuration version in reporting scope. Existing currency lock/source claims must be verified in EO05B before writer activation; no client/default-account inference.
FX_policy.source_selection: Existing EO05B verification of FX source, supported currency coverage and date/weekend policy remains; no new external request/provider selected here.
FX_policy.old_rates: New revisions do not silently overwrite old rate evidence or reprice facts.

persistence_boundary.storage_DTO: Separate versioned storage input; not validateCanonicalFunnelFact with rules weakened to accept missing FX/name. Existing adapter and PD bridge remain unchanged in this delivery.
persistence_boundary.source_to_fact: Require committed verified owner-bound source, all relevant native proof, current authority/fence and no pending mandatory deletion. A fact receipt is not source receipt; handoff must be atomic with actual accepted consumer outcome.
persistence_boundary.pending: Native missing identity remains in raw evidence. Product mapping/Channel/FX states independent; storage does not turn held provider proof into validated output.
persistence_boundary.privacy: Before new table activation, enroll actual facts/provenance/extension contents in existing erasure manifest, scoped worker, retention dependency checks and no-reingestion rules. No second privacy engine.
persistence_boundary.retention: Source90/metadata365 stays unchanged. Dataset fact expiry requires an explicit approved policy version/finite retain_until before activation; 90-day UI range is not a new retention policy. Read/replay/extension enrichment does not auto-renew the original lifetime.
persistence_boundary.operational: Existing queue/checkpoint/reconciliation/lease tables serve operations; five means logical Dataset families, not five tables in entire application.

existing_open_gates: Klaviyo Shopify metrics unavailable, not zero
Backup/restore EO08C and real customer delivery EO07A/EO08D
not_changed: EO05C maturity and EO05D replay/correction implementation
acceptance_before_implementation: Owner reviews this concrete five-family layout and extension rules.
Exact mapping to existing canonical/source fields and native grain is checked before writing each family; missing proof never becomes ready.

SQL writer implementation must test numeric precision, cross-owner FK, same-native-key extension update, source receipt versus actual consumer receipt, rollback/unknown/CAS and mandatory erasure of derived contents.
Register optional synthetic new-metric compatibility test and type/unit rejection when writer/registry is implemented. These behavioral tests are not claimed by this document-only PR.
